apps.name: EscapeOS
apps.subtitle: On-device file browser and backup tool for another app's Data container
apps.localizedDescription: Browse, edit, back up and restore another app's Data container on device: Documents, Library and tmp, file copy and compress/extract (zip, 7z, tar, gz, bz2, xz, lz4, lzma, deb), SQLite viewing, and SHA-256 manifests on every backup. No jailbreak, no Keychain. Requires iOS 26.0 or later, LocalDevVPN and a pairing file placed by iPASide.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Added

- **App Groups.** An app's page lists its groups when the install record includes them, and opens a group that has a folder. Reset App Data still does not touch groups.
- **Import a backup.** Backups, Import Backup copies an exported EscapeOS backup zip back into Files, On My iPhone, EscapeOS, Backups. A zip that is not one of these backups is refused. An existing name is kept.

## Changed

- **Search Whole App.** A file opens the folder it is in and marks that file. A folder still opens.
- **iOS 26.0 is the minimum.** The IPA does not install below that.

App Groups, search, and backup import were confirmed on device the same day.
